questions.question: King Solomon gathered the leaders of Israel in Jerusalem to bring up which sacred object from the City of David?

answers.text: The ark of the covenant of the LORD
The bronze serpent that Moses made
The sword that belonged to Goliath

questions.question: When the ark was placed in Solomon's temple, which of these filled the house so the priests could not minister?
God told King David he would not be the one to build the temple for God's Name. Who would build it?
When the priests set the ark in the Most Holy Place of Solomon's temple, what was inside it?

answers.text: The tablets and a jar of manna
